vol_region_props — 3D regionprops op

• Data kinds: labels → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vol_region_props(labels, spacing=None, surface='auto') (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import volops; volops.vol_region_props(labels, spacing=None, surface='auto'), registry से लेना हो तो ops3d.get("vol_region_props"))

उपयोग

label volume से हर component के quantitative descriptors।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

*labels* is the int volume returned by vol_label (or any integer labelling; voxels <= 0 are background). Pass *spacing* (sz, sy, sx) (or

a volio.VolumeMeta) to report physical volume in mm**3 and physical surface area in mm**2. *surface* selects the surface-area estimator:

"auto" (marching cubes when scikit-image is importable, else exposed faces), "marching" (require marching cubes), or "faces" (always the face count).

Returns a list[dict] (one per label 1..n, in ascending label order), each with:

label id · voxel_count · volume (voxels, or mm**3 with spacing) · centroid (z, y, x) in voxel-index coordinates · bbox (z0, z1, y0, y1, x0, x1) with exclusive upper bounds (slice stop) · surface_area (voxel-face units, or mm**2 with spacing) · sphericity (Wadell, ~1 for a sphere, lower for a slab; approximate — see module note).
